interposer.export: KiCad 10.0.6 PCB GLB export with native copper, pads and silkscreen. R9 is partial: 160 MC1/MC2 contacts and six GTY pairs routed (TX0 plus reserved TX2 per cable); TX1 and control remain open on every cable; 109 unconnected items. Physical DRC is clear only under provisional 0.15 mm study rules; 19 schematic-parity warnings remain. Power and JTAG circuits are not placed. Six custom stack connector 3D bodies are missing.

interposer_r12.export: KiCad 10.0.6 native GLB export including tracks, pads, zones, inner copper and silkscreen. Single-link schematic maps all 19 numbered contacts with ERC 0; PCB retains 45 physical components. Independent copper audit: 10/19 contacts complete to all intended native endpoints, 8/8 serial conductors, 160 MC1/MC2 and 67 remaining MC3 pass-throughs, 13 isolated BRK contacts, no shorts. Current unsuppressed DRC: 0 physical errors, 11 dangling warnings, 9 opens, 0 parity issues. Four JTAG nets and ground branches remain open, including eFuse ground. Six custom stack connector 3D bodies are absent. Provisional HDI rules; no fabrication release.
